metadata.description: Jetpack Compose UI component skill for lumo-ui — 24 components, Gradle plugin setup, theming, and KMP support

plugins.name: lumo-ui
plugins.description: AI skill for lumo-ui, a Gradle plugin that generates Jetpack Compose UI components into Android and KMP projects. Includes all 24 components (Button, TextField, ModalBottomSheet, NavigationBar, TopBar, Accordion, AlertDialog, Badge, Card, Checkbox, Chip, Divider, Icon, IconButton, OTPTextField, ProgressIndicator, RadioButton, Scaffold, Slider, Snackbar, Surface, Switch, Text, Tooltip), theming with AppTheme/Colors/Typography, and Kotlin Multiplatform setup.
